Definition
[Almost separably valued] ↗ def:separable-space 1. appE:E.5-def-4\group Vector-Valued Integration

A function $f:[0,T]\to X$ is almost separably valued if there is a set $N\subset [0,T]$ with $|N|=0$ such that \[ \{ f(t)\mid t\in [0,T]-N\} \] is separable.
